item.title: 10 Principles for Building Reliable Voice Agents on LiveKit
item.description:
Voice agent demos are easy to build. A LiveKit worker, an STT → LLM → TTS pipeline, and you have something that talks. The hard part is making it reliable.

We run AI call agents on LiveKit. An call lasts up to an hour. A lost recording is a compliance problem. A lost transcript means the user has to redo the call. A silent agent means a human sitting in an empty room, wondering if anyone is there.
